content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Marietta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with extended experience. Verify you meet PMI's education and hours requirements before enrolling. Granite PM Academy staff can review your background against PMI's criteria and clarify any questions about your readiness to apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. The instructor-led course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Attend all sessions synchronously, participate in case studies, and complete assignments to earn the full 35 contact hours PMI requires.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp coursework, apply directly to PMI through their portal. Upload proof of your education, work experience, and Granite PM Academy's completion certificate. Pay PMI's examination fee to activate your candidacy and secure your exam appointment window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor-led review sessions. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Upon passing, you earn the PMP credential and join thousands of certified professionals across Marietta's aerospace, healthcare, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential Over Three Years
steps_items.text: PMI requires you to earn professional development units (PDUs) across each three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Pursue PDUs through conferences, courses, volunteer work, and other approved activities. Renew your credential before expiration to continue demonstrating your commitment to project-management excellence.
